facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 62°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 6 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Heavenly Valley (8,540 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Heavenly Valley
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: June 14 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: left April 27; earlier seasons: June 30 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Heavenly Valley (8,540 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft).

evidence.name: Heavenly Valley
evidence.detail: 2.6 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 58.2 in (2023), 24.8 in (2024), 22.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: 2.5 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 54.0 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 19.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 4 and May 21, carried from the melt-out dates at Heavenly Valley (8,540 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Heavenly Valley
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 272 ft below the pass; points to March 31 to May 17

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 27, 232 ft below the pass; points to April 8 to May 24

campgrounds.name: South Lake Tahoe-El Dorado Recreation Area
